arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Cortina argued the Ninth Circuit violated federal law by reversing the state court.
Mr. Gits argued the state court correctly identified exclusive jury considerations.
Justice Souter questioned the basis for claiming no reasonable likelihood of error.
Justice Kennedy questioned whether the trial court failed to correct the prosecutor.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines how federal courts review state death penalty trials. It clarifies when prosecutor statements about the law require judicial correction. The outcome affects the finality of state criminal judgments.
